description: This file implements ticker scheduling and trigger functions for Nordic Semiconductor's Bluetooth controller, including caller ID management and scheduling of ticker jobs and workers.

methods.name: hal_ticker_instance0_caller_id_get
methods.description: Returns the caller ID based on user ID, with validation.

methods.name: hal_ticker_instance0_sched
methods.description: Schedules ticker jobs or workers based on caller and callee IDs, with support for multiple call chains.

methods.name: hal_ticker_instance0_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets the ticker compare register to trigger an event at a specified value.
